messages:
lina (DevEx): Quick one — a customer ran our Python quickstart and their first call fails with 402 / {"error":"billing_not_enabled"}. They said they completed checkout and added a card.

lina (DevEx): Their exact snippet: ```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('RWD_API_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('hello')
print(resp)
```

ella (Support): Did they create the workspace via SSO or were they invited? 402 usually means the workspace-level billing flag hasn't been accepted by an org admin.

lina (DevEx): They were invited by an admin. But here's the twist — the quickstart container image sets RWD_WORKSPACE to "demo-org-test" by default and the user didn't override it. They thought they were hitting their workspace but the token was for their org account and the workspace env pointed at a different (stale) workspace with billing disabled.

jorge (SDK): Ahh, env mismatch. SDK doesn't validate that api_key belongs to RWD_WORKSPACE if workspace header is set explicitly. We bubble the 402 from the API.

lina (DevEx): Customer reported it as "SDK broken" because our README didn't highlight the default RWD_WORKSPACE in the docker sample.

ella (Support): Short-term reply to customer: verify RWD_WORKSPACE matches Console workspace slug OR unset it to use the token's default. Also check Console -> Billing to Accept Terms.

jorge (SDK): Two fixes: 1) Update quickstart container to NOT set RWD_WORKSPACE by default (PR #4120). 2) Add a helpful client-side check in Python SDK: if user supplies RWD_WORKSPACE and API returns billing_not_enabled, print a message suggesting workspace/token mismatch and show both values if available.

finance-bot: Billing flag changed: workspace demo-org-test -> pending_activation (triggered by payment method add).

lina (DevEx): Can we also add a one-line sanity check to the top of the quickstart: `echo "Workspace: $RWD_WORKSPACE, API_KEY owner: $(rwd whoami)"` so users see the mismatch immediately?

jorge (SDK): Good idea. I'll add that and a more descriptive error mapping: transform 402/billing_not_enabled -> "Billing not enabled for the workspace in RWD_WORKSPACE (or the token's workspace). Check Console -> Billing and ensure your api key and workspace env match." Includes link to console.

onboarding-bot: Task created: quickstart-docker-env-cleanup (assigned to @lina).

ella (Support): I'll reply to the reporter with the quick checklist: 1) unset RWD_WORKSPACE OR set it to your workspace slug, 2) ensure admin accepted Billing Terms in Console, 3) retry.

jorge (SDK): Also adding telemetry event for first-call 4xx with env RWD_WORKSPACE set so we can see how many users hit this. PR #4121.

lina (DevEx): Thanks y'all. Once quickstart changes land I'll update the README and the sample container so this doesn't confuse folks onboarding for the first time. :white_check_mark:
